faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: A short guide to what people ask most often. If your question isn't listed, message us.

price.a: The cost depends on the area, property type, frequency and scope of work. We don't publish "from" prices, because two cleanings of the same area can differ many times over in workload. Fill in the estimate on our site or message us — we'll reply with a specific amount once we've clarified the details.

calculation.a: The base parameters are area and frequency. The scope of work is added on top: windows, sanitization, grounds, landscaping. For regular service we offer a monthly price under contract. On-site visit for inspection and measurements: [confirm terms].

regular.a: Yes, this is our main format. Daily, several times a week, weekly or monthly — we tailor the schedule to the property's operating hours and record it in the contract.

business.q: Do you work with offices and organizations?
business.a: Yes, we work with legal entities under contract. Documents for accounting: [confirm: invoice, completion act, payment method]. A responsible manager is assigned to your property.

renovation.a: Yes. We remove construction dust from all surfaces, mortar and paint residue, wash windows and doors, and finish with a wet floor cleaning. Removal of small construction debris is discussed separately.

territory.q: Can you maintain grounds on an ongoing basis?
territory.a: Yes. Cleaning of surrounding grounds, keeping things in order, care of lawns and flower beds, seasonal planting — all of it can be included in one contract along with interior cleaning.
